title: Refine it into a pack you'll reuse
goal: Refine your template into a small, reusable pack — tighter tone and ready-made variants — with small follow-ups, not a restart.

blocks.title: A template gets better with use
blocks.body:
Your saved template already works. Now make it a pack that covers more situations — not by starting over, but with small, specific follow-ups.

Ask AI things like: "add a gentle-reminder version for parents who missed the first message", "add a short WhatsApp version under 40 words", "give me a warmer and a more formal opening line". One template quietly becomes three, and you paste whichever one fits the day.

blocks.template: You want one notice template to serve first-time, reminder, and last-call situations. The follow-up that gets you there: {{move}}.

options: add a gentle-reminder variant and a final-reminder variant, keeping the same blanks
rewrite the whole notice from scratch with a completely new tone
make the single notice much longer so it covers everything at once

blocks.scaffold: Improve this template into a small reusable pack: add a gentle-reminder variant and a short WhatsApp version (under 40 words), keep the same [blanks] across all versions, and offer one warmer and one more formal opening line.

blocks.question: How confident are you that you'll actually reuse this template pack next week?
